summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached news release announcing the repricing and extension of 500,000 previously granted incentive stock options held by certain advisors. The exercise price was reduced from $1.00 to $0.63 per share, and the expiration date extended from December 31, 2026 to December 31, 2028. This is a routine compensation-related action involving stock options, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are applicable. The filing does not trigger any special-situations classification beyond a standard corporate governance update.
